verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean does not introduce the distribution H_a as an object and then assert membership in H^{-3}; it encodes the same statement dually, one component at a time. For each k, `averagedPressureDifferenceValue` is the explicit functional psi |-> <(H_a)_k, psi> obtained by integrating the time-averaged equation by parts (Laplacian term, time-derivative term, tensor terms, and the Riesz pairing that realises pi_*), and `averagedPressureDifferenceValue_bound` states |<(H_a)_k, psi>| <= C sqrt(fourierHNormSq 3 psi), where `fourierHNormSq 3 psi = int (1+|xi|^2)^3 |psi-hat(xi)|^2` is exactly the squared H^3 norm. A functional on test functions bounded by the H^3 norm is precisely an element of H^{-3}; the recovery is the standard duality H^{-3} = (H^3)^*, applied componentwise to the vector H_a. The weight a and the time integral are carried inside W0, W1, G as time averages rather than written outside. No constant, exponent or Sobolev index differs.
